description: Active-passive multi-region Azure deployment with primary region serving production traffic, secondary region warm standby, geo-replicated SQL and storage, Front Door health-probe failover, and runbook-driven DNS or traffic manager cutover within a four-hour RTO.
constraints: RPO under 15 minutes for transactional data
RTO under 4 hours for full regional failover
Failover drills quarterly with evidence capture
requiredCapabilities: Azure Front Door or Traffic Manager
Azure SQL geo-replication or Cosmos DB multi-region writes
Azure Site Recovery or paired-region App Service slots
Azure Key Vault with regional redundancy
Azure Monitor alert routing to on-call
assumptions: Secondary region sized for 70% of peak load during failover
Configuration and secrets replicated via IaC pipeline, not manual edits
